      "title": "compliance: T9 is assessed clause by clause against the SPEC_V2 \u00a712 gate and the plan's D1\u2013D5 scenarios. The Preliminary and artefact clauses are proved by `crates/api/tests/architecture_artifacts.rs::a_catalog_is_queryable_rows`, `::an_approved_artefact_is_immutable`, `::reuse_is_searchable_across_plateaus` and `crates/api/tests/architecture_capability.rs::the_profile_names_the_mandatory_set`, `::a_maturity_assessment_needs_every_dimension`, `::a_skills_assessment_names_its_role`. The design gate is proved by `crates/api/tests/togaf_delivery_design_gate.rs::a_delivery_project_without_a_contract_cannot_pass_design`, `::a_superseded_contract_refuses_design` and `::a_live_contract_opens_the_design_gate`; the one-level and dated-waiver clause by `crates/api/tests/architecture_compliance.rs::one_level_and_a_dated_waiver`. The fifth clause, an H review producing exactly one change or kata, is not proved: open finding v1-p81-6 records that Phase H enforces existence, not exactly one typed outcome, and the plan's `crates/api/tests/togaf_h_change.rs::a_systemic_finding_produces_a_kata_candidate` does not exist at HEAD; the file carries `::a_scope_change_produces_a_change_register_row` and `::an_unrecorded_review_refuses_the_gate`, and `crates/actions/tests/togaf_kata_outcome.rs::a_bare_kata_outcome_is_refused` and `::a_kata_outcome_names_a_kata_candidate_of_the_project` prove typed kata outcomes. Six findings remain open: v1-p81-4, v1-p81-5, v1-p81-6, v1-w2a-3, v1-w2a-4 and v1-w2a-6; six were resolved at `92e6b223` (v1-p81-1, v1-p81-2, v1-p81-3, v1-w2a-2, v1-u5a-t9-1, v1-u5a-t9-2). The compliance level is non_conformant. The rework's acceptance instrument is `acceptance/programme/T9.toml`.",
      "value": "T9 is assessed clause by clause against the SPEC_V2 \u00a712 gate and the plan's D1\u2013D5 scenarios. The A\u2013F order, draft refusal and contract-reopen clauses are proved by `crates/api/tests/togaf_architecture_phases.rs::phases_a_to_f_pass_in_order`, `::a_draft_artefact_refuses_the_contract`, `::a_contract_change_reopens_the_gate`. The design gate is proved by `crates/api/tests/togaf_delivery_design_gate.rs::a_delivery_project_without_a_contract_cannot_pass_design`, `::a_superseded_contract_refuses_design` and `::a_live_contract_opens_the_design_gate`; the one-level and dated-waiver clause by `crates/api/tests/architecture_compliance.rs::one_level_and_a_dated_waiver`. The fifth clause, an H review producing exactly one change or kata, is not proved: open finding v1-p81-6 records that Phase H enforces existence, not exactly one typed outcome, and the plan's `crates/api/tests/togaf_h_change.rs::a_systemic_finding_produces_a_kata_candidate` does not exist at HEAD; the file carries `::a_scope_change_produces_a_change_register_row` and `::an_unrecorded_review_refuses_the_gate`, and `crates/actions/tests/togaf_kata_outcome.rs::a_bare_kata_outcome_is_refused` and `::a_kata_outcome_names_a_kata_candidate_of_the_project` prove typed kata outcomes. Six findings remain open: v1-p81-4, v1-p81-5, v1-p81-6, v1-w2a-3, v1-w2a-4 and v1-w2a-6; six were resolved at `92e6b223` (v1-p81-1, v1-p81-2, v1-p81-3, v1-w2a-2, v1-u5a-t9-1, v1-u5a-t9-2). The compliance level is non_conformant. The rework's acceptance instrument is `acceptance/programme/T9.toml`."
